source_manifest.provenance: Original procedural geometry authored for BalloonBarrage. No third-party geometry, image, texture or download was used.
source_manifest.license: Project-authored assets; repository distribution terms apply. These assets are distinct from the separately attributed CC0 libraries.
source_manifest.generationMethod: Deterministic C# geometry construction. This specification is retained verbatim as design provenance, not an AI raster-image prompt.
source_manifest.creativeSpecification: Create four original, cheerful low-poly flower clusters for BalloonBarrage's sunny coastal world. DaisyCluster: five gently curved green stems, pointed curved leaves, ten distinct ivory-white spoon petals around each raised golden center. CoralTulips: four stems with long upright green strap leaves, six overlapping coral and peach petals forming an unmistakable open tulip cup with scalloped tips and a small golden interior. BluebellCluster: four bending stems, basal lance-shaped leaves, three hanging blue-violet bells per stem on curved branchlets, open darker interiors and five-lobed flared rims. SunflowerCluster: three taller leafy stems, fourteen broad yellow radial petals per tilted head, large dark-brown seed discs and seven small golden-brown seed details. Keep rooted bases at local ground height zero, varied stem heights, approximately 0.55 to 1.10 meters total height, recognizable close-up silhouettes, gentle curves with visible low-poly facets, bright natural colors, opaque closed or double-sided geometry, fewer than 5000 triangles per complete cluster, one shared-material mesh per prefab, and no colliders, scripts, animation or gameplay. Generate all geometry mathematically in C#; use no raster image generation, external meshes, textures or downloaded source material.
source_manifest.scope: Static decorative prefabs only. Geometry checks do not establish movement, gameplay, frame rate or a playable release.
Static environment refinement and native Edit Mode renders. No gameplay, navigation, planting interaction, Play Mode or performance acceptance.
source_manifest.assets: Twenty CC0 Nature Kit 2.1 details plus four original native procedural flower species. Original OBJ/MTL/license bytes and earlier assets remain unchanged; no generated raster image is used.
source_manifest.placement: Mixed-height pollinator beds, shop window boxes, bowl planters, crop soil/edging, furnished stalls, campsite details and grouped shore stones. Existing visible crops preserved; intersecting random trees/rocks and their matching proxies removed.
verificationNotes: Native saved-scene reload passed all three original routes and all four southern routes plus two spurs using the existing support/capsule contract.
Scene-local refinement preserves parent GUIDs and source asset bytes. New flowers are visual static models; no gameplay or runtime components authored.
Flower stems and planter insertions use grounded prepared prefabs. Coasts interpolate the existing sloped band; source scene and shared render pipeline remain unchanged.
Before/after file hashes outside the owned scene/detail roots must also pass the external protected-file audit.

protectedFileAudit.scope: SHA-256 compared against pre-refinement local snapshot; includes gameplay scripts, original scenes/art, raw sources and ProjectSettings. Current expansion scene, seven regenerated PNG captures and evidence records are the intended changes.

source_manifest.creativeSpecification: Author original narrow, gently curved, tapered grass blades as three reusable short/medium/tall tuft meshes. Each tuft has 24 blades in an irregular 0.5-metre radius, three bend segments, 0.012-0.030-metre blade widths, ground-level roots, and three natural green tones. Heights vary around 0.18, 0.30 and 0.46 metres. Double-sided triangle geometry has no alpha texture, animation, scripts or collision. Scatter deterministically on verified grass support only, outside paths, mulched beds, crops, buildings and solid scenery; combine by 16-metre spatial cells and provide a sparse static distant LOD. Ground uses an unmodified separately credited CC0 PBR lawn surface at project-chosen 2-metre tiling. Preserve all original sources and scene GUIDs.
source_manifest.scope: Saved static grass appearance, spatial visual LOD and native Editor captures. No movement, wind simulation, gameplay, Play Mode, streaming or runtime performance acceptance.
source_manifest.surface: ambientCG Grass005, CC0-1.0, unmodified source JPEGs. Provider describes Procedural with Bitmap Elements. Photographic-style PBR surface, not a claim of pure photogrammetry. Project-chosen 2-metre repeat; provider physical dimensions unspecified. Neutral material tint; OpenGL normal at 0.40 strength; roughness packed into nonmetal smoothness with maximum 0.18.
source_manifest.originalGeometry: Deterministic native C# ribbon geometry. No generated raster images or downloaded grass model. Actual double-sided blades supplement the CC0 surface; four original flower species retain separate provenance.
source_manifest.lod: 16m spatial cells. LOD0 retains all tufts; LOD1 retains every fourth tuft; thresholds 0.12/0.025 relative screen height. Content triangle inventories count both LOD meshes although only one level displays at a time. Not a measured frame-time claim.
verificationNotes: All original and southern route support/clearance contracts passed on saved-scene reload. Grass has no collision or runtime scripts.

6122 original 24-blade tufts in 141 spatial LOD cells; 1469280 full-detail triangles and 379920 sparse-distance triangles. Static inventory includes both LOD levels, not simultaneous rendering or performance acceptance.

Placement uses five downward support rays per accepted tuft footprint, rejects paths/plazas, excludes mulch/crop rectangles and expands solid obstacle bounds. Raw source pixels unchanged; normal importer and derived packed mask are separately prepared.

protectedFileAudit.scope: Compared SHA-256 against pre-grass snapshot. Existing art, source textures, flower meshes/prefabs, paired metadata/GUIDs, scripts, other scenes and ProjectSettings remain unchanged. Current expansion scene and refreshed capture/evidence files are intentional edits.

meshStorage.method: Remove only unreferenced vertices introduced by combining material submeshes. Compare every triangle corner position, normal, tangent, UV, color, material slot and bounds before/after reimport. GUIDs and local file IDs are unchanged. No triangle removal, simplification or visible geometry change; existing captures remain valid. Native text serialization and project settings remain unchanged.
